name: mfe-poc
description: Flavor 1 POC: a realistic Angular host loading self-contained web-component MFEs at runtime from a manifest (pure isolation, no federation).

scripts.build:mfes: ng build mfe-orders && ng build mfe-profile
scripts.build: npm run build:mfes && npm run assemble && ng build host
scripts.start: npm run build:mfes && npm run assemble && ng serve host
